an8.46:6.1: “Sir, I had gone into retreat for the day’s meditation.
an8.46:6.2: Then, sir, several deities of the Agreeable Host came up to me, bowed, stood to one side, and said to me:
an8.46:6.3: ‘Honorable Anuruddha, we are deities of the Agreeable Host. We wield authority and control over three things.
an8.46:6.4: We can turn any color we want on the spot.
an8.46:6.5: We can get any voice that we want on the spot.
an8.46:6.6: We can get any pleasure that we want on the spot.
an8.46:6.7: We are deities of the Agreeable Host. We wield authority and control over these three things.’
an8.46:6.9: ‘If only these deities would all turn blue, of blue color, clad in blue, adorned with blue!’
an8.46:6.10: Then, sir, those deities, knowing my thought, all turned blue.
an8.46:7.2: ‘If only these deities would all turn yellow …
an8.46:7.4: would all turn white, of white color, clad in white, adorned with white!’
an8.46:7.5: Then, sir, those deities, knowing my thought, all turned white.
an8.46:8.1: Then, sir, one of those deities sang, one danced, and one snapped her fingers.
an8.46:8.2: Suppose there was a quintet made up of skilled musicians who had practiced well and kept excellent rhythm. They’d sound graceful, tantalizing, sensuous, endearing, and intoxicating.
an8.46:8.3: In the same way the performance by those deities sounded graceful, tantalizing, sensuous, endearing, and intoxicating.
an8.46:8.4: But I averted my senses, sir.
an8.46:9.1: Then, sir, those deities, thinking ‘Master Anuruddha isn’t enjoying this,’ vanished right there.
